response.overview: A 16mm exploration of religion, trauma, and material filmmaking. Hand developed in home-made caffenol solutions, hand animated frame by frame.  a shout into the thunderous silence, a need for answers  An environmentally conscious choice to develop in as non-toxic a solution as possible left indelible marks and layers on the film. Choosing to create every aspect by hand made it a process of repetition and ritual.  Entering the developing room with potential and emerging three hours later, covered in sweat and water and coffee stains, with an image that was always tantalizingly imperfect and at various times frustrating, disheartening, and liberating; echoing the journey through trauma recovery.  These rituals of introspection and physical rituals of development and animation became a lens to examine the relationships between religious ecstasy, dogma, and the physical work of recovery.
response.title: silver like dust
